scientific_integrity: The complete prism average-mixing rank is proved analytically for every integer \(n\ge3\); finite numerical checks are corroboration, not certification. The main arithmetic input is proved as a Kronecker-type algebraic-integer lemma. No claim of independent validation, human audit, or priority beyond inspected sources is made.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted adjacency-driven, uniform infinite-time Cesaro averaging of \(C_n\square K_2\) at unit rung coupling is covered. Further spectral coincidences can arise for other couplings. An equivalent earlier unpublished or unindexed result may exist.
title: Modulo-twelve resonance in quantum average mixing on prisms
